# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> Comprehensive online dictionary and language reference platform providing definitions, translations, grammar explanations, and vocabulary learning tools for English language learners of all levels.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries offers multiple specialized dictionaries including Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Oxford Advanced American Dictionary, and Oxford Learner's Dictionary of Academic English, along with interactive grammar guides, vocabulary word lists, and learning resources aligned to CEFR proficiency levels.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- Oxford Advanced American Dictionary
- Oxford 3000 and 5000 vocabulary lists
- Practical English Usage
- Academic English
- CEFR levels
- Grammar explanations
- Word definitions and pronunciations
- Collocations
- English language learning
- Advanced learners
- Vocabulary learning
- Language reference
- Bilingual dictionaries
- Interactive practice exercises

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Homepage](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us): Main entry point for Oxford Learner's Dictionaries with access to definitions, translations, and grammar tools
- [Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english): Comprehensive English dictionary with definitions, audio pronunciations, and usage examples for advanced learners
- [Oxford Advanced American Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/american_english): American English dictionary with definitions and pronunciation guides for American English learners
- [Oxford Learner's Dictionary of Academic English](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/academic): Specialized dictionary for understanding academic vocabulary and writing in academic contexts
- [Oxford Collocations Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/collocations): Dictionary showing word combinations and collocations for more natural and accurate English expression
- [English-German School Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/translate/schulwoerterbuch): Bilingual English-German dictionary designed for school learners with translations and language examples
- [Definitions Hub](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition): Central hub for accessing word definitions, grammar explanations, and learner resources

## Grammar and Language Reference

- [Practical English Usage](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar/practical-english-usage): Authoritative grammar guide by Michael Swan with over 600 entries on English grammar and usage
- [Grammar Hub](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar): Central reference for grammar explanations, interactive exercises, and language terminology
- [Learn & Practice Grammar](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/grammar/online-grammar): Interactive grammar learning platform with practice exercises aligned to CEFR proficiency levels

## Vocabulary and Word Lists

- [Oxford 3000 and 5000](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlists/oxford3000-5000): Essential vocabulary lists covering the most important 3000 and 5000 words organized by frequency and CEFR levels
- [Word Lists Browser](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlists): Browse and explore curated vocabulary word lists organized by CEFR proficiency levels
- [My Word Lists](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/mywordlist): Premium feature for creating personalized word lists and practicing vocabulary with flashcards
- [Topic Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/topic): Thematic vocabulary dictionaries grouping words by subject areas and specialized topics
- [New Words](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/wordlist/new_words): Browse recently added words and meanings to the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary

## Learning Resources and Support

- [Resources](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/resources): Free printable activities, worksheets, and lesson plans for vocabulary building and writing practice
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/faq): FAQ section addressing common questions about dictionary access, word lookup, and grammar materials

## Optional

- [Example Word Entry - 'often'](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/often): Sample word entry demonstrating definition, pictures, pronunciation, and usage notes format
